name: octen
description: Real-time web, news, image and place search, page extraction, embeddings and cited answers for agents
long_description: Bring an Octen API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it in the `x-api-key` header. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists one of your monitors (GET /monitors), which is not billed. A Sprite can then run Octen's search APIs (Pulse, Web, Broad, Web Premier, News, Business, Place, Design and Image Search), extract pages, create text and multimodal embeddings, get cited answers, run Search Agent and Deep Research tasks, start grounded image or video generations and poll them, and read existing monitors with their runs and events. Every request except the monitor reads and the task polls is billed pay as you go from your Octen balance. Monitor creation, updates, deletion and manual triggers, Video Search (invite-only beta) and the Auto Search model routes (chat completions, messages, image and video generation) are not forwarded.

messages.400: Octen rejected the request parameters; see msg for the field
messages.403: Octen balance is insufficient or this plan does not cover the request; add credits at octen.ai/platform
messages.404: Octen could not find that task, monitor or run, or the task has expired
messages.429: Octen rate limit reached; back off and retry (honour Retry-After when present)
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Octen; retry later

presentation.tagline: Search the live web, extract pages and get cited answers from a Sprite without putting your Octen key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in to the Octen API Platform at octen.ai/platform and create an API key. Octen requires a payment method; new accounts get $5 of free balance.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key lists one monitor (`GET /monitors?limit=1`), which is not billed; monitors are billed only per run. Everything else except monitor reads and task polls is charged pay as you go to your Octen balance: Pulse Search $0.10 to $0.20, Web and Broad Search $1, Image Search $2, News Search $3, Web Search Premier $4 and Business, Place and Design Search $5 per 1,000 calls; full content beyond the free results $0.50 per 1,000; Extract $1 (standard) or $2.50 (advanced) per 1,000 successful URLs; embeddings per token; Answer by searches plus model tokens; Search Agent $0.05 to $0.50 per task; Deep Research $0.20 to $3 per request; grounded generation $0.25 per image and $1 per video. A Search Plan changes some of these; see docs.octen.ai/overview/pricing.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /pulse-search`, `/search`, `/broad-search`, `/search-premier`, `/news-search`, `/business-search`, `/place-search`, `/design-search`, `/image-search`, `/extract`, `/embedding`, `/vl-embedding`, `/answer`, `/v1/agent`, `/v1/research` and `/v1/grounded-generation`, and `GET /v1/agent/:task_id`, `/v1/grounded-generation/:generation_id`, `/monitors`, `/monitors/:id`, `/monitors/:id/runs`, `/monitors/:id/runs/:run_id` and `/monitors/:id/events` are forwarded. Monitors are read-only: creating, updating, pausing, deleting and triggering them are not forwarded. Video Search (invite-only beta) and the Auto Search model routes (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`, `/v1/images/generations`, `/v1/videos`) are not forwarded either.

usage_notes: Responses are `{"code": 0, "msg": "success", "request_id": "...", "data": {...}}`; errors carry a non-zero `code` (usually the HTTP status, six digits for monitor errors) and a `msg`.

Search Agent and grounded generation run in the background: start the task, then poll its `GET` route until `status` is final. Deep Research (`POST /v1/research`) always streams Server-Sent Events, and may stop after a plan that needs confirming; call it again with `plan_id` and `selections`, or set `skip_plan_confirm: true`.
Grounded generation results are signed download links on apt-multimodal-output.octen.ai. They need no key, are not proxied by the gateway, and expire 7 days after the task was created.
